text_en: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to Jerusalem to test him with hard questions, having a very great retinue and camels bearing spices and very much gold and precious stones. When she came to Solomon, she discussed with him all that was on her mind.
text_cn: 舍巴女王听见了撒罗满的声誉，就来到耶路撒冷，考问撒罗满一些难题；陪从她的人很多，骆驼驮着许多香料、黄金和宝石；进见撒罗满时，便将所有的心思都对他说了出来。

text_en: Solomon answered all her questions; there was nothing hidden from Solomon that he could not explain to her.
text_cn: 撒罗满对她所问的一切难题，一一给她解答了，没有一样可难住撒罗满，而不能给她解答的。

text_en: When the queen of Sheba had observed the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,
text_cn: 舍巴女王看见了撒罗满的智慧和所建造的宫殿，

text_en: the food of his table, the seating of his officials, and the attendance of his servants, and their clothing, his valets, and their clothing, and his burnt offerings that he offered at the house of the Lord , there was no more spirit left in her.
text_cn: 筵席上的肴（yáo）馔（zhuàn），群臣的坐次，仆从的侍候和服装，酒正与酒正的服装，和在上主殿内的全燔祭，惊讶得出神，

text_en: So she said to the king, “The report was true that I heard in my own land of your accomplishments and of your wisdom,
text_cn: 遂对君王说：“关于你的作为和智慧，我在我国内所听到的，的确是真的。

text_en: but I did not believe the reports until I came and my own eyes saw it. Not even half of the greatness of your wisdom had been told to me; you far surpass the report that I had heard.
text_cn: 以前我原不相信这些传闻，及至我来亲眼见了，才知人告诉我的还不及你伟大智慧的一半；你实在超越了我所听闻的。

text_en: Happy are your people! Happy are these your servants, who continually attend you and hear your wisdom!
text_cn: 你的妻妾是有福的，你的臣仆是有福的，能常侍立在你面前，聆听你的智慧。

text_en: Blessed be the Lord your God, who has delighted in you and set you on his throne as king for the Lord your God. Because your God loved Israel and would establish them forever, he has made you king over them, that you may execute justice and righteousness. ”
text_cn: 上主，你的天主应受赞美！他喜爱你，使你坐他的王位，代上主你的天主为王；因为你的天主爱慕以色列，要永远保持他们，所以使你作他们的王，来秉公行义。”

text_en: Then she gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones: there were no spices such as those that the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
text_cn: 舍巴女王遂将一百二十“塔冷通”黄金，大批香料和宝石，赠送给君王：舍巴女王赠给撒罗满王的香料这样多，是从来未有过的。

text_en: Moreover the servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon who brought gold from Ophir brought algum wood and precious stones.
text_cn: 从敖非尔运金子的希兰的仆人和撒罗满的仆人，也运来了檀香木和宝石。

text_en: From the algum wood, the king made steps for the house of the Lord and for the king’s house, lyres also and harps for the singers; there never was seen the like of them before in the land of Judah.
text_cn: 君王用檀香木为上主的殿和王宫制造了栏干，为歌咏者制造了琴瑟；像这样的东西，在犹大地方从来没有见过。

text_en: Meanwhile King Solomon granted the queen of Sheba every desire that she expressed, well beyond what she had brought to the king. Then she returned to her own land, with her servants.
text_cn: 凡舍巴女王所愿所求的，撒罗满都奉送给她；此外，尚有君王为酬谢她赠送的礼品；以后她和她的仆人回了本国。

text_en: The weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,
text_cn: 撒罗满每年收入的金子，重量有六百六十“塔冷通”，

text_en: besides that which the traders and merchants brought; and all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the land brought gold and silver to Solomon.
text_cn: 商人小贩所运来的，以及阿剌伯的诸王和本国太守给撒罗满所进献的金银，尚不计算在内。

text_en: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of beaten gold went into each large shield.
text_cn: 撒罗满王又用锤打的金子，作了二百个盾牌，每个用锤打的金子六百“协刻耳”。

text_en: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three hundred shekels of gold went into each shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
text_cn: 又用锤打的金子，作了三百小盾牌，每个用金三百“协刻耳”；君王把这些盾牌都悬在黎巴嫩林宫。

text_en: The king also made a great ivory throne, and overlaid it with pure gold.
text_cn: 君王又用象牙制造了一个大宝座，用纯金包镶。

text_en: The throne had six steps and a footstool of gold, which were attached to the throne, and on each side of the seat were arm rests and two lions standing beside the arm rests,
text_cn: 宝座有六级台阶，座背后有一只金羔羊，座位两边有扶手，扶手两旁立着两只狮子。

text_en: while twelve lions were standing, one on each end of a step on the six steps. The like of it was never made in any kingdom.
text_cn: 六级台阶上立有十二只狮子，每级两个，一左一右；在任何国家从没有过这样的制造法。

text_en: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; silver was not considered as anything in the days of Solomon.
text_cn: 撒罗满王所有的饮器，都是金的；黎巴嫩林宫的器具，都是纯金的；撒罗满时代，银是不值什么的。

text_en: For the king’s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram; once every three years the ships of Tarshish used to come bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
text_cn: 原来君王的船只与希兰的仆人一同去塔尔史士；去塔尔史士的船只，每三年往返一次，运来金银象牙，猿猴和孔雀。

text_en: Thus King Solomon excelled all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.
text_cn: 这样，撒罗满王的富贵和智慧，超过了世上所有的君王。

text_en: All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put into his mind.
text_cn: 世上所有的君王都想见撒罗满的面，听听天主赋予他心中的智慧；

text_en: Every one of them brought a present, objects of silver and gold, garments, weaponry, spices, horses, and mules, so much year by year.
text_cn: 各人带来自己的礼物：银器、金器、衣服、兵器、香料、骡马，年年都是如此。

text_en: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horses, which he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 撒罗满有四千厩（jiù），为养马存车，有一万二千骑兵，驻扎在屯车城和耶路撒冷君王左右。

text_en: He ruled over all the kings from the Euphrates to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
text_cn: 撒罗满统辖列王，由大河到培肋舍特人领域，直到埃及边陲。

text_en: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stone, and cedar as plentiful as the sycamore of the Shephelah.
text_cn: 君王在耶路撒冷有的银子，多如石头，香柏木多如平原的桑树。

text_en: Horses were imported for Solomon from Egypt and from all lands.
text_cn: 撒罗满所有的马，都是由慕兹黎和各地运来的。

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, from first to last, are they not written in the history of the prophet Nathan, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of the seer Iddo concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat?
text_cn: 撒罗满其余的前后事迹，都记载在先知纳堂的《言行录》，史罗人阿希雅的《预言书》和先见者依多论及乃巴特之子雅洛贝罕的《启示录》上。

text_en: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
text_cn: 撒罗满在耶路撒冷作全以色列王凡四十年。

text_en: Solomon slept with his ancestors and was buried in the city of his father David; and his son Rehoboam succeeded him.
text_cn: 撒罗满与他的列祖同眠，葬在他父亲达味城内；他的儿子勒哈贝罕继位为王。
